title: Combine type opens and uniform finite-model descent
statement: Let X be a scheme and Λ a finite commutative ring. Suppose a pro-etale sheaf F of Λ-modules has a scheme pro-etale covering with finite constant module models M_i [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Then it has an etale covering indexed in the universe of X with finite constant module models, allowed to vary with the covering member.

source.place: Tag 099Y, proof of lemma-compare-locally-constant; Combine type opens and uniform finite-model descent

proof.text: Descend the loci where the model has type M_i to opens O_i covering X.

Base change the original covering to O_i. Every nonempty base-change member has module type M_i by the characterization of O_i. Transport its given trivialization through upperStarComp and constant pullback and then through a model isomorphism. On empty members any two module sheaves are isomorphic since all sections are terminal.
Apply uniform finite-model etale descent on each O_i.

For each x ∈ X choose an O_i containing x. Take the disjoint union, indexed by pairs (x,a), of the etale covering of that chosen open. This is a universe-small etale covering of X. Compose inverse-image isomorphisms and retain each finite module model.

theorem etale_cover_of_proetale_finite_models
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hF : ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ X),
      Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X ∧
        ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
          Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (g i)).obj F ≅
              (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀,
      ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.upperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (𝒰.f i)).obj F ≅
            (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology (𝒰.X i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)
